_source: Hardcore Worlds (OSRS, 4 November 2026; docs/hardcore-worlds.md). Captured: live rsprox sessions of revision 242.1 on Hardcore worlds 634-670 (world flags 2049) and a Hardcore character at Death's Office on world 335, 2026-11-04/05 (20261104T112753, 20261104T120418 and the death broadcasts of every session). The death choice's texts are the cache's (hc_death_choice 982, scripts 10240-10249). Entries under `ours` were not captured and replace nothing live says.

greeting.npc: Greetings, mortal. I've been expecting you.

newSoul.npc: Indeed... A new soul to partake in my challenge.

options.continue: I would like to play Hardcore Mode. How do I continue?
options.leave: I no longer want to play Hardcore Mode. How do I leave?
options.more: Could you tell me more about Hardcore Mode?

more.npc: It is a challenge of my creation. I have created special worlds for Hardcore players where death is a greater threat.
These worlds have their own economy, separate from other worlds. Hardcore players may freely trade others.
Most important to me is that Hardcore players only have one life. Once you lose it, you have a choice to make.
If you are undaunted by large setbacks, you can try again. A completely fresh start, as if you had only just arrived here for the first time.

Or you could choose to continue where you left off, but do so on Non-Hardcore worlds. You will lose all the items on your person, except any protected items, but otherwise your items and progress are retained.

more.player: Speaking of progress, is there an easy way for me to keep track of that?

more.npc: If you wish to see how you're doing, you simply need to look upon yourself. I have a mirror here that you can use to do just that.
Now, did you have any other questions?

cannotReclaim.npc: You cannot reclaim anything from me.

ours._note: Not captured: the live answers on a Hardcore world to these options, and the choice's confirmation. Replace them from a capture.

continue.npc: Step through the portal behind you, and my challenge begins.

leave.npc: On these worlds there is no leaving my challenge, mortal. When your life ends, you will choose how to go on.

who.npc: I am Death. Here, I keep the rules of my challenge.

where.npc: My office. Every Hardcore soul begins its journey here.

ours.transferTaken: You already have a character on the Non-Hardcore worlds, so this one cannot be transferred.
ours.noIronmen: There are no Ironmen on Hardcore worlds.
ours.noPresets: Presets are not available on Hardcore worlds.
